claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition S-03 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F10; type EXPLICIT; SUBJECTIVE; THERAPEUTIC; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: MIXED / CONFLICTING. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: Acute autonomic and subjective change is not durable relief

evidence_items.text: Chevalier & Sinatra 2011 (n=27) reported acute heart-rate variability changes interpreted as reduced stress.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Acute autonomic surrogate; no durable stress endpoint.

evidence_items.text: Ghaly & Teplitz 2004 and Chevalier et al. 2019 report subjective stress improvement.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Uncontrolled n=12 and a 16-participant stepped-wedge dataset; self-report only.

evidence_items.text: Kim M-H & Lee E-Y 2025 reported stress z=-3.58, p<.001.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Statistically strong but arises inside a 12-week combined barefoot forest-walking programme in which exercise, nature, social and researcher contact cannot be separated.

evidence_items.text: Park et al. 2025 day-31 perceived stress (BEPSI) between-group p=.756.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: A prespecified between-group stress comparison that was null.

evidence_items.text: Lin et al. 2022 reported no between-group anxiety or depression effect.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Adjacent affective endpoints were null in the best-controlled 12-week trial.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: Positive signals are acute or confounded; the prespecified controlled comparisons were null.

detected.rationale: Durable stress reduction is asserted from acute autonomic surrogates and self-report while prespecified between-group stress and affective comparisons were null.
A confounded 12-week menopause walking programme and a 16-participant occupational cohort are generalised to a general audience.

reader_impact.affected_decision_type: Purchase; possible substitution for stress management.
reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That stress reduction is a demonstrated, lasting product effect.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Stress claims are broadly appealing and rarely checked; the risk is misplaced reliance rather than acute harm.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: No specific frozen label applies; the operative error is asserting a durable effect from acute and confounded signals against null prespecified comparisons.
uncertainty.ambiguity: MATERIAL — Steelman credited repeated positive signals; the adversarial layer showed the strongest one is not attributable and the controlled ones were null.
missing_evidence: Acute autonomic and subjective change is not durable relief
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: No independent validated stress trial with sham or active control and durability follow-up exists.

verdict.verdict_summary: Positive stress signals are acute, self-reported, small or confounded by a combined walking programme, and they sit beside two null prespecified comparisons. No durable stress-reduction endpoint under sham control was located.
